answer: An agent economy resists Sybil swarms with a refundable per-identity stake posted before any earnings. Each new alias escrows liquidity scaled to its claimed throughput; audit failure forfeits the stake to honest peers. A farm of clones must therefore lock capital for every fake at once, so ten thousand duplicates cost ten thousand deposits, not one script. Like a comet, each clone drags a long, locked tail. A sonnet is chained to its meter, and the stake chains spendable funds to one verified lane, as a jetty funnels a boat.
